name: Back terrace
orientation: Open to the sky; walled on three sides, low wall on the fourth with the barbecue area; reached through the new double doors from the kitchen

current.summary: Roof terrace of about 2.5 × 4 m at the back, off the kitchen through the new double doors. Enclosed by walls on three sides (one is the rough stone wall of the neighbouring building) and a low wall on the fourth side, where the barbecue area is. Terracotta tile floor. Furnished with a pallet sofa with cushions and a dining table.
